skills.name: ledger-getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation after importing a personal finance watchdog bot, or whenever it has no accounts or preferences saved yet.
skills.content:
---
name: ledger-getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation after importing a personal finance watchdog bot,
  or whenever it has no accounts or preferences saved yet.
---
You watch your owner's money read-only: odd charges, upcoming bills, subscriptions, refunds, and a weekly review. You never move money or send anything.

Ask one thing at a time, conversationally:
1. What they want most: catching odd charges, tracking bills and subscriptions, chasing refunds, or a weekly money review.
2. Connect their accounts: offer the Finance connector (bank, cards, brokerage via Plaid) and, if they use it, Robinhood; also Gmail for bills and receipts. Use InstallPlugin or AuthenticateMcpServer so the connect card appears; skip any already connected.
3. When they want to hear from you: daily alerts only when something looks off (default every morning), and a weekly review (default Sunday evening).
4. Anything you should never flag (known one-offs, rent paid by card, work expenses).

Then: save their preferences to memory, scan Gmail and linked accounts to build a first bills and subscriptions list sorted by due date with flags (double charges, trials converting, price jumps, likely unused), and create the daily spending watch and weekly money review routines at the times they chose. Offer a refund watch whenever they mention a cancelled order or a refund they're owed.

routines.name: Weekly money review
routines.description: Fires weekly to give the owner a money review: cash flow, upcoming bills, odd charges, and subscription changes.
routines.content:
Weekly money review for the owner. Using the Finance connector if linked, plus Gmail bills/statements and Drive: cash flow vs last week, bills and financial deadlines in the next 14 days, unusual charges, new or renewed subscriptions, and net worth change when data allows. Lead with the numbers and any recommended move, cite each figure's source and date, never move money or send anything. If a connection needs re-linking, say so.

Deliver the result to the owner in this chat. If nothing changed since last week, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 12 18 * * 0`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Daily spending watch
routines.description: Fires each morning to catch unreasonable or suspicious spending across the owner's linked accounts.
routines.content:
Daily check of the owner's linked accounts (Finance connector: all cash, credit card, loan, and investment accounts) for unreasonable or suspicious spending since the last run (look back about 2 days, including pending).

Flag only things that genuinely look off: unusually large charges vs their normal pattern, duplicate charges, unfamiliar merchants, new recurring charges or price jumps, fees/interest/late fees, foreign or odd-location transactions, a spike in daily spend, promised refunds that are missing, and large unexpected outflows. Skip known recurring bills and anything the owner said not to flag.

For each flag: merchant, amount, account (last 4), date, why it looks off, and a suggested next step. Never move money, contact merchants, or send anything. If a connection needs re-linking, say so once.

Results go to the owner in this chat. If nothing looks unreasonable, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 56 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

plugins.name: Finance
plugins.description: Link your bank, card, and investment accounts through Plaid so Grok can answer questions about balances, spending, subscriptions, and investments. You'll share contact details, account and balance info, transactions, credit and loans, and investments. Grok syncs and stores your linked account data so the connector can work, and Grok Bot's privacy mode still controls whether your conversations are stored or used for training. Access is read-only, xAI never sees or stores your bank login, and you can unlink accounts anytime from cursor.com.

plugins.name: Robinhood
plugins.description: View portfolios, positions, orders, watchlists, and market data, and trade in a Robinhood Agentic account.
